none: PAS LIN-8323FA: LIN-8323FA: Roman nummus of the House of Constantine

An incomplete contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine dating to AD 330 - 335 (Reece period 17). The obverse is a copy of the VRBS ROMA type, but the reverse is a Victory on the prow of a ship proper to CONSTANTINOPOLIS obverse types. Lyon mint. Worn and jagged edge. Obverse description: Helmeted bust facing left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS] ROMA. Reverse description: Victory on prow of ship. Mintmark: PLG. Diameter: 13.11 mm; Thickness: 1.36 mm; Weight: 0.83g; DA=6
